propositions: CLI rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no referencing commit when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is outside the code worktree, even though rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD correctly resolves the trailer.
close_precheck._completion_precheck derives code_root as os.path.dirname(tracker), causing git -C and completion-gate config to scan the tracker parent directory instead of the current code worktree.
The defect either emits a false missing-commit diagnostic or silently closes unsigned, depending on whether completion-gate config exists at the tracker parent.

Code root resolution must use config.repo_root(repo_root) (explicit → REBAR_ROOT → cwd Git toplevel) to scan the caller/current checkout, while tracker reads continue through config.tracker_dir(repo_root).
Completion-gate configuration and referencing/file-impact checks must consistently use the correct code_root, not the tracker parent, to avoid silent gate bypass or false rejection.
